lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular array of high-luminance circular clusters located posterior to the gill slits, displaying a higher spatial frequency in the mid-lateral region compared to the dorsal area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a localized rectilinear grid pattern on the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp transition from high pixel intensity on the superior edge to low intensity shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced network of high-contrast white caustic lines caused by surface light refraction, overlaid across the cephalic, pectoral, and dorsal regions.
